decontamination_notes: Real bug fix from rust-lang/regex PR #1364 (fixes issue #1354), merged 2026-07-15T20:13:56Z. Labeled decontaminated: true because the fix post-dates the May 2026 training cutoff of the models this suite targets (Claude Opus 5); re-check `upstream_merged` against any newer model's cutoff before reusing. When a pattern has no usable prefix literal but an extractable suffix or inner literal, the meta engine scans for that literal to generate candidate positions and confirms each with a search; if the first candidate confirmed a match starting later than one confirmed by a subsequent candidate, the non-leftmost match was returned. Minimal reproducer: `.bb|b` on `zabb` reports 2..3 instead of 1..4. Per the upstream description this can never cause a false positive or false negative, only a wrong span. This is the largest gold patch in the suite -- 18 source files across regex-automata and regex-syntax, ~1618 changed lines -- so it is labeled veryhard/multi_file and is expected to sit in the frontier-hard tail rather than be routinely solved. Repo sliced at the PR base commit (926af2e6), trimmed to the root `regex` crate plus its two in-repo path crates (regex-automata, regex-syntax); the regex-capi, regex-cli, regex-lite and regex-test workspace members, all dev-dependencies, and the repos' own test targets are dropped. NOTE: the root manifest ships `autotests = false` with explicit [[test]] targets; those targets are stripped with the dev-dependencies, so the slice sets `autotests = true` for the injected vb_ tests to be discovered -- do not revert this. External deps aho-corasick and memchr (both required for the literal-optimization path that carries the bug -- trimming them would hide it) are vendored into repo/vendor with a .cargo/config.toml replace-source stanza; verified fully offline with `docker run --network none ... cargo build --offline`. The vendor tree also carries the optional arbitrary/syn/proc-macro2/quote chain that `cargo vendor` collects feature-agnostically; it is unused at the built feature set and could be pruned to shrink the 5.6M vendor tree. MIT/Apache-2.0 licenses preserved. Coverage: 7 fail_to_pass tests, each verified to report a wrong span at the base commit and the correct span after the gold patch. Five are the upstream regression cases from testdata/regression.toml (reverse-suffix-start-of-match-failure-010/011/012/020/030); the other two assert the same leftmost span through the Captures and find_iter APIs, so the fix must hold across three public entry points rather than just Regex::find. The 5 pass_to_pass guards cover a prefix-literal alternation, a plain literal, leftmost-then-first alternation, a non-matching haystack, and an anchored pattern -- none depend on candidate ordering, so they compile and pass at the base commit without referencing the fix. All expected spans are generated from the gold patch.
